Apple___Apple_scab.description: Dark scaly spots on leaves and fruit surface

severity.mild: Few scattered spots, less than 10% leaf area affected
severity.severe: Heavy infection, fruit deformed, more than 30% affected

treatment: Apply during early morning or evening
Repeat every 10-14 days during wet season
Apple___Apple_scab.season: Spring to early summer, worse in wet conditions

Apple___Black_rot.description: Brown to black rotting spots on fruit and leaves

severity.mild: Small brown spots on leaves only
severity.moderate: Spots on both leaves and fruit
severity.severe: Fruit rotting, mummified fruit on tree

treatment: Remove and destroy infected fruit immediately
prevention: Remove mummified fruit from tree and ground
Apple___Black_rot.season: Summer, spreads rapidly in warm humid conditions

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.description: Bright orange-yellow spots on leaves and fruit

severity.mild: Few orange spots on leaves only
severity.severe: Heavy spotting, early leaf drop, fruit infected

treatment: Apply at pink bud stage before infection
prevention: Remove nearby cedar or juniper trees if possible
Apply protective fungicide before rainy season
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.season: Spring, requires both apple and cedar trees nearby

Apple___healthy.description: No disease detected, tree appears healthy
prevention: Monitor for early signs of disease
